method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across revelation measured to capacity, healing and living growth, continuity of purpose beside changing laws, the images of education, seasons and sunlight, recognition and prophetic succession, the Báb’s account of unending revelation, and humility about finality with the gradual application of teachings. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: Although the former Manifestations have come from God, the means of unity for mankind was not prepared in their time. It was as though there was nothing, and conflicting conditions were still remaining in the world; there was no transportation and railways, no joining of Europe, Asia and Africa. People could not meet each other, the means were not ready.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the means of world unity, such as transportation, were not ready in the times of former Manifestations; a concrete explanation of why unity belongs to this age.

selected.text: What I have spoken is according to the capacity of the people and the exigency of the time. "The father makes gurgling sounds for the newborn infant, although his wisdom can measure the universe."
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that He speaks according to the capacity of the people, as a father makes gurgling sounds for an infant; a vivid image of disclosure measured to capacity.

selected.text: If a king send many different governors to rule a city, and the people obey all but the last one, it will be to the king as though they disobeyed all.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that obeying all a king’s governors but the last is disobedience to the king; a memorable parable of recognizing every Manifestation.

selected.text: Moses taught only the material things and Christ of the Spiritual. So if Adam attempted the knowledge of Jesus Christ, he was bound to fail.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Moses taught material things and Christ the spiritual, so Adam could not have received Christ’s knowledge; a brief contrast of successive stages.

selected.text: Christ gave new life and effect to the meanings of the ancient law.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Christ gave new life to the meanings of the ancient law; a brief statement of renewal as revival.

selected.text: The teaching is ever the same, it is only the outward forms that change.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the teaching is ever the same and only the outward forms change; the most concise form of the guide’s distinction between essence and form.

selected.text: No, gradually, for a plant that grows too quickly lasts only a short time

selected.text: The Promised One of all nations, Baha'u'llah, has appeared and manifested, and with new teachings has revived the world.
selected.reason: Tablet of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Bahá’u’lláh, the Promised One of all nations, has revived the world with new teachings; a concise declaration of renewal.

selected.text: Whenever this world becomes dark, and divided in its opinions and indifferent, God will send one of His Holy Messengers.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that whenever the world becomes dark and divided God will send a Holy Messenger; a brief promise of renewal.

selected.text: This is He Whom Adam heralded, until the matter reached the Interlocutor whom We commanded, through what We revealed in the Qur'an
selected.reason: Bahá’u’lláh’s statement that Adam heralded this Day until the matter reached the Interlocutor; a brief testimony of earlier heralds.

selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that without change there is no renewal, and had the religion of Moses not changed Christ would not have appeared; a concise logic of renewal.

selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a physician changes his prescription with the patient’s condition; the concise form of the guide’s physician image.

selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Bahá’u’lláh proves the truth of Christ, Islam and Abraham to unbelievers; shows a new revelation confirming earlier ones.
